full_judgment: 4. The petitioner then filed a suit for damage with a prayer for conducting the suit as pauper and the application was registered as Miscellaneous Case No.7 of 2005 by the Joint District Judge, 5th Court, Dhaka. After hearing the parties the said Court rejected the application on 03.02.2006 refusing to accord permission to institute the suit as being pauper.
